name: Jazz concerts
added: In November 2026, saxophonist Kovacs is scheduled to perform at Bitef Art Cafe in Belgrade on both November 4 and November 5 (venue address: Bitef Art Cafe, Belgrade, Serbia). The larger Belgrade Jazz Festival runs earlier, from October 21‑24 at Dom omladine Beograda (address: Dom omladine Beograda, Belgrade, Serbia), with its programming extending into November though no specific November concerts are listed beyond the Kovacs shows. This information reflects web sources retrieved on 2026‑10‑30.
